title: Palestinian factions agree on membership of Gaza post-war governance committee, Egypt says
summary: All 15 members of a Palestinian committee intended to administer post-war Gaza have been agreed upon by the parties included in the US-brokered ceasefire plan, Egypt's foreign ministry said on Wednesday. The US said the plan was ready to move into its second phase with the goal of disarming Hamas, rebuilding the devastated enclave and daily governance.
